beats.caption: You know that one task you just... do? You don't even think about it — you just get it done.

beats.title: You'd Freeze
beats.caption: But if someone asked you to write down exactly how, you'd freeze.

beats.title: Don't Write It
beats.caption: Here's what actually works: don't try to write it.

beats.title: Just Hit Record
beats.caption: Next time you're doing that task, just hit record on your phone and talk through it. First I do this, then I check this.

beats.title: Throw It Into AI
beats.caption: Then take that recording, drop it into AI, and say: turn this into steps.

beats.title: Documented
beats.caption: Done. That's your whole process, documented — and you didn't write a single word.

beats.title: In Your Head
beats.caption: The knowledge was already in your head. You just never had to say it out loud.
